prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished transparent production RTS animation atlas, NOT concept art. Input reference is ONLY character identity; entirely remove card border, background and scene. Preserve SAME armor, anatomy, colors, equipment and silhouette. Create ACTUAL DIFFERENT DRAWN BODY/WEAPON ANIMATION POSES, no static cutout transformations.
Strict 24 COLUMNS by 8 ROWS of equal rectangular cells on a 2:1 landscape canvas, NO margins, NO lines, NO text. Precisely192 full-body sprites on transparent alpha background, each sprite fits within own cell and baseline is steady. Isometric RTS overhead camera, 35degrees downward. CRITICAL ROW FACINGS: row1 NORTH, BACK VIEW, show back of head/backpack NOT face, pointed AWAY toward top of screen; row2 NORTHEAST REAR-RIGHT view, show back+right shoulder; row3 EAST side view, points right; row4 SOUTHEAST front-right view; row5 SOUTH FRONT VIEW, face toward bottom of screen; row6 SOUTHWEST front-left view; row7 WEST SIDE VIEW points left; row8 NORTHWEST REAR-LEFT view, show back+left shoulder. ROTATE THE CHARACTER IN3D among rows, not rotate canvas. Every frame within a row faces that row's exact compass direction. Four rear-view rows must visibly show back surfaces.
In EVERY ROW columns1-4 = complete subtle idle breathing/readiness sequence; columns5-10 =6 genuinely articulated continuous gait/movement frames with distinct left-contact, passing, lift, right-contact, passing, lift, no excessive bobbing; columns11-15 =5 distinct attack preparation, strike/fire contact, recoil/swing followthrough and recovery frames; columns16-17 =2 genuine hit recoil poses; columns18-22 =5 death sequence standing failure, buckle, fall, collapsed body, fading debris appropriate material; columns23-24 =2 special ability channel/activation poses unique to subject. Entire character remains a consistent size and stable pivot. Animate legs/arms/claws or wingbeats/treads correctly. Death may collapse but stays within cell. No ground tiles or dramatic shadows, no duplicate poses, no extra characters. Fine painted textured sci-fi sprites, strong contrast, readable atsmall RTSsize. True transparency, soft edge alpha; no background color.
Subject specifics: Engineer: blue-lit gray armored infantry worker with compact welding/tool arms; six walk frames real stride; attack melee tool swing, special/work welding arc.
